image.subject: Digory and Polly standing side by side in a warm green wood, faces slack and eyes half-closed, soft green light falling through the leaves

storyboard.claim: The wood's calm makes the children forget who they are.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory and Polly standing side by side in green light, faces slack and eyes half-closed.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opens the wood section after the warning about its nature.
storyboard.addedInformation: The danger is the wood's calm, not a monster.

image.subject: Digory and Polly stand side by side in green light beside still pools, both with calm loose faces and hands at their sides, gazing away and not touching

storyboard.claim: They almost forget they must rescue each other.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two children stand still side by side in green light, relaxed, not touching.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the apathy from the wood.
storyboard.addedInformation: The rescue bond is what is at risk.

image.subject: Digory standing motionless beside a still green pool, face blank and calm, leaves drifting around him

storyboard.claim: The peace of non-existence is more frightening than a monster.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory standing motionless beside a still green pool, blank face, leaves drifting around him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the apathy in the previous beat.
storyboard.addedInformation: Blank calm reads as the threat.

image.subject: A strip of cut turf laid on the mossy bank beside one pool, marking the way back to London, a boy's hand resting on it

storyboard.claim: A strip of turf marks the pool that leads back to London.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Turf laid on the bank beside the London pool.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The children have to act to stay themselves.
storyboard.addedInformation: The turf is their anchor to reality.

left.label: UNCLE ANDREW
left.subject: Uncle Andrew, wild grey hair and a dressing gown, bending eagerly over a pool with greedy curiosity

right.label: DIGORY
right.subject: Digory, a slim boy in a grey jacket, looking down at a green ring on his finger beside a pool, uncertain

storyboard.claim: Digory's curiosity mirrors his uncle's, with one difference.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Uncle Andrew and Digory each eyeing a pool with a ring.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the turf to the pools.

image.subject: Digory and Polly at the edge of a ring of several still pools, each reflecting a different sky, Digory pointing to another

storyboard.claim: They could go home, but Digory wants to explore one more pool.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory pointing to one more pool among the ring of still pools.

image.subject: Digory and Polly holding hands, green rings on their fingers, stepping together toward the edge of a dark pool

storyboard.claim: Digory takes the physical risk himself, and they go together.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two hands joined, rings on, stepping to a pool.

image.subject: A blur of warm green light giving way to a grey cold sky, a pool's water still rippling

storyboard.claim: The warm green is instantly replaced by a biting cold.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A blur of green light giving way to a grey, cold sky over a rippling pool.
storyboard.addedInformation: The world changes in one cut.

image.subject: Digory and Polly standing in a cracked stone courtyard under a swollen dying red sun, black ruined towers around them

storyboard.claim: They stand in the ruins of a massive dead courtyard under a dying red sun.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two small figures in a ruined courtyard under a red sun.
storyboard.addedInformation: The red sun marks Charn as dying.

image.subject: Two children walking slowly down a long stone hall lined with pale statues of royalty, red light falling across the cold floor

storyboard.claim: They enter a great hall of frozen royal figures under bloody light.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Children walking in a hall lined with pale royal statues.
storyboard.addedInformation: The statues are a line of rulers.

image.subject: A row of pale stone royal statues, the nearest with gentle kind faces, lit in blood-red light beside the children

storyboard.claim: The first rulers' faces are noble and kind.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two children stopping before the nearest pale statues, which have gentle faces in red light.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sets the baseline for the decline.

image.subject: Close view of a line of pale stone royal faces, each further along harder and crueler, carved in red light

storyboard.claim: Generation by generation the faces grow crueler and more arrogant.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Close view of the statues' faces, each one harder than the last, down the line.
storyboard.addedInformation: The decline is visible in the faces.

image.subject: Jadis, a tall, beautiful woman with black hair and a cold white face, a long dark gown with a silver crown, standing at the end of the line of statues in red light

storyboard.claim: At the end of the line stands Jadis, terrifying and beautiful.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis standing as the tallest figure at the end of the line of statues.

image.subject: A small pillar with a golden bell and a hammer resting beside it, in front of Jadis's statue, red light on the metal

storyboard.claim: A pillar holds a golden bell in front of Jadis.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Golden bell on a pillar with a hammer.

storyboard.claim: An inscription tells the stranger to make a choice.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The inscription carved into the pillar beside the bell.

storyboard.claim: Striking the bell brings danger or wonder.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The bell and pillar in dark red light, the question printed over them.

storyboard.claim: The trap exploits the human inability to tolerate mystery.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Plain statement on a dark ground, no picture.

image.subject: Polly gripping Digory's sleeve, eyes wide, urging him toward the way out under the red light

storyboard.claim: Polly feels the malice and says they must leave.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Polly pulling at Digory's sleeve.

image.subject: Digory struggling with Polly, pulling her back by the arm across a stone floor, both straining in red light

storyboard.claim: Digory is infected by the same arrogant curiosity as his uncle.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory physically holding Polly back.

image.subject: Digory swinging a hammer at a golden bell on a pillar, his other hand gripping Polly's arm, red light

storyboard.claim: Digory grabs Polly and strikes the bell with the hammer.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory swings a hammer at the bell while holding Polly's arm.

left.label: POLLY
left.subject: Polly pulled back by the arm, holding her ring hand to her chest, frowning in red light

right.label: DIGORY
right.subject: Digory's firm grip on her wrist, face set in determination

storyboard.claim: Digory forces his will onto Polly to satisfy his ego.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Polly held back by Digory.

image.subject: Cracked stone ceiling of a ruined palace falling in clouds of dust, the golden bell glowing, a tall black-haired shape stirring on a stone throne

storyboard.claim: The bell rings, the roof collapses, and Jadis wakes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The ceiling cracking and falling in dust while a tall black-haired figure stirs.
storyboard.addedInformation: The disaster is set in motion.

image.subject: Jadis leading the children through a crumbling palace corridor, her silver crown catching red light

storyboard.claim: Jadis leads them out and reveals the history of Charn.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis leading through ruins.

image.subject: A ruined palace wall at dusk, torn banners hanging over a broken gate, red sky overhead

storyboard.claim: Jadis refused to surrender to her sister's winning armies.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Broken gate and torn banners.
storyboard.addedInformation: Shows the stakes of her refusal.

storyboard.claim: The word destroys every living thing except the one who speaks it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Plain statement on a dark ground, no picture.
storyboard.addedInformation: The cost of the word is total.

storyboard.claim: Lewis writes at the dawn of mutually assured destruction.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text statement.
storyboard.addedInformation: Ties the story to the Cold War.

storyboard.claim: Jadis says she was the queen.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis's own words on screen, the line she speaks to Digory.

storyboard.claim: Jadis preferred a dead world over a world she could not rule.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis's words on a dark ground, the line about her people.

storyboard.claim: The deplorable word is the pinnacle of power you cannot take back.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text statement.

image.subject: Digory alone in a red-lit ruin, one hand pressed to his forehead, realizing his mistake, Jadis's shadow behind him

storyboard.claim: Digory realizes he woke the architect of destruction.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Digory alone with a hand to his forehead, Jadis's shadow behind him.

image.subject: Two children's hands touching yellow rings together over a stone floor in red light, the rings glowing

storyboard.claim: They touch their rings, but magic requires physical contact.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Hands touching glowing yellow rings.

image.subject: A tall black-haired woman's hand gripping a boy's ear at the edge of a glowing ring, both pulled toward a swirl of light

storyboard.claim: Jadis grabs Digory's ear and is dragged along by the ring.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis's hand gripping Digory's ear at the edge of a glowing ring.

image.subject: Three figures clinging together in a swirling dark wood of pools and lights, a woman's hair streaming, the rings glowing

storyboard.claim: They are pulled through the wood between the worlds with Jadis clinging.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three figures clinging together in the swirling wood of pools and lights.

storyboard.claim: They are dragged back into Uncle Andrew's study in 1900.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text statement.

image.subject: A wet Edwardian London street at night with gaslamps and a horse cab, a dark tall figure hurrying past under the lamps

storyboard.claim: The collision of realities hurls us into the London street.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A wet London street at night, gaslamps and a horse cab, a tall dark figure hurrying past.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Next beat in the London street.

image.subject: A stuffy Victorian study with velvet chairs and a ticking clock, a tall black-haired woman in a long dark gown standing in dim light

storyboard.claim: Jadis is alarming in the dead red light but out of place in a Victorian study.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis in the study.

left.label: JADIS
left.subject: Jadis, a towering black-haired woman in a long dark gown and silver crown, fury in her face

right.label: AUNT LETTY
right.subject: Aunt Letty, a stout middle-aged woman with hair pinned up and a lace collar, stern face

storyboard.claim: Jadis towers over Aunt Letty, who walks in.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis beside Letty.

image.subject: Aunt Letty in a study doorway, arms crossed, frowning at a tall woman in strange clothes

storyboard.claim: Letty sees a shameless woman from a circus, not a sorceress.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letty frowning in the doorway.

storyboard.claim: Letty tells her there is no strong language in this house.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Quoted line.

image.subject: Jadis towering over Aunt Letty, fire flashing in her eyes, one hand raised

storyboard.claim: Jadis speaks the words that destroyed her world, aiming at Letty.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jadis raising her hand over Letty.

image.subject: Aunt Letty standing calm and unmoved before a stunned Jadis, both in the dim Victorian study

storyboard.claim: Nothing happens; power is contextual.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Letty unmoved, Jadis stunned.
